periods.label: 红莲皇女与落第骑士相遇

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二公主

status.relationship: Ikki's girlfriend and rival by end of volume

appearance.overview: A striking foreign beauty with ruby eyes and vivid flame-red hair.

attire.combat: Laevateinn, a flaming two-handed sword; Empress Dress flame mantle

distinctive: fiery aura and scattered sparks when emotional

personality.summary: Proud, passionate, easily embarrassed, but fundamentally brave and fair-minded.
fears: becoming complacent as a praised genius
desires: win the Seven Stars Sword Art Festival
stand beside and eventually fight Ikki
personality.inner_conflict: She wants to be recognized for effort rather than merely talent and learns to respect Ikki's different kind of strength.

decision_pattern.crisis: protects innocents first even at personal cost

voice.self_reference: 我 / 本公主 when angry
quote_samples: 不要用你们放弃的理由去否定一辉的强悍！
我这次绝对不会再输给你！

habits.daily_routine: Joins Ikki's severe morning runs despite hardship.
quirks: takes her self-imposed servant promise too seriously

background.upbringing: Praised as a rare genius but trained hard after struggling to control flames that burned her own body.

education.entry: highest entrance score in school history

formative_events: spent three years mastering Dragon Breath
left home to avoid stagnation and seek stronger opponents
background.pre_story: Came to Japan before the entrance ceremony as a foreign exchange student.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Initially angry roommate and duel opponent; becomes the person she admires, loves, and promises to challenge again.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Jealous rival for Ikki's attention but comes to respect her during the hostage incident.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Acquaintance who helps during the mall outing.
relationships.shizuya-kirihara: Despises his cowardly hunting style and bets on Ikki's victory.

secrets: Falls in love with Ikki before openly admitting it; worries about whether he finds her attractive.
periods.summary: Stella arrives as an A-rank princess and top freshman, accidentally becomes Ikki's roommate, loses to him in a duel, and chooses to remain his room partner. She trains with him, clashes with Shizuku, protects hostages during the Rebellion incident at the cost of public humiliation, wins her first selection battle by intimidation, publicly defends Ikki against jeering spectators, and accepts his confession under the moon.

key_events.summary: Is seen changing by Ikki and reacts with fury.
Loses to Ikki's Ittou Shura and begins respecting him.
Reveals herself to save a mother and child from Rebellion gunfire.
Her overwhelming flame pressure makes Momotani surrender immediately.
Accepts Ikki's love and vows to meet him in the final.
